review.conclusion_reason: Operative OPEN and an unknown first_end are appropriate because neither order's operative text is available in the supplied evidence. However, categorical formal_status revoked_or_superseded exceeds the project's requirement for quoted express supersession from the later instrument. Record OFR-reported supersession as a lead pending that text. No held order text supports T1, so the cumulative ceiling is T0.

verdicts.reason: The cited Archives 1942 table, lines 1112–1114, confirms the title and signing date. This identifies the order but supplies no original text.
The quotation is accurate at line 1116, but not received for publication does not establish the stronger historical claim that it was never subsequently published.
The cited Archives 1942 table, line 1115, expressly records supersession by EO 9427-A dated February 29, 1944. It is an editorial disposition entry, not the acting instrument.

The Archives 1944 table, lines 154–158, confirms the title, date and classified/nonreceipt note. It does not establish present classification or that no public source can supply the superseding words.
The cited Wikisource page contains the quoted publication notice and metadata, with no operative order text.
